description:
About our brand and products

Fantak Packaging is a professional one-stop destination for high-quality floral and gift packaging. We specialize in providing florists, wholesalers, and creative boutiques with the essential tools to elevate their floral art. Our curated catalog includes:

  • Artisanal Wrapping: Premium silk fabrics, 180g Italian-style crepe paper, and waterproof flower wrapping sheets.

  • Gift Vessels: Luxury flower boxes (including letter shapes), floral bags, and specialty sleeves.

  • Decorative Accents: A wide array of decorative ribbons, gold satin trims, colorful cellophane, and floral vase.

  • One-Stop Solution: We cater to businesses of all sizes, offering the ability to purchase small quantities to avoid expensive bespoke costs.

 What makes us different

We stand out in the 2026 floral market by focusing on "Sustainable Luxury" and "Professional Accessibility."

  • Quality Consistency: Unlike generic suppliers, our products are selected for their tactile feel and durability, specifically designed for high-end "Nordic" and "Boho" floral aesthetics.

  • Small Batch Friendly: We empower small flower boutiques by offering premium supplies in manageable quantities, eliminating the need for massive bulk overhead.

  • Visual Trendsetter: Our products are designed to be "camera-ready," helping florists create content that thrives on Instagram and Pinterest.

  • Customer-First Experience: We prioritize the florist’s journey, offering direct links to supplies and a focus on adding value to your brand efficiently.

 How affiliates can earn

Our affiliate program is designed to reward the creative community that uses our products every day.

  • Competitive Commission: Earn a percentage (e.g., 10%) on every successful referral made through your unique link.

  • 7-Day Cookie Window: If a customer clicks your link and buys anything within the next 7 days, you receive the credit.

  • Tiered Rewards: High-performing affiliates may qualify for higher commission rates or exclusive early access to new seasonal collections.

  • Monthly Payouts: Reliable, transparent tracking via our affiliate dashboard ensures you are paid on time for your influence.

How to promote us

We encourage authentic, visual-first promotion that showcases our supplies in action:

  • Tutorials & DIYs: Create Reels or TikToks showing "How to wrap a bouquet" or "DIY Flower Box arrangements" using Fantak supplies.

  • "Unboxing" Content: Share the tactile quality of our papers and ribbons when your order arrives.

  • The "Final Look" Tags: Post your finished floral masterpieces on Instagram and tag the specific Fantak packaging used in the caption or via a "Link in Bio."

  • Blog Reviews: Write about your "Must-Have Florist Supplies for 2026" and include your affiliate links for each item.

## • Other information

  • Global Shipping: We support international shipping to help florists worldwide access professional-grade packaging.

  • Support: Our dedicated team is available to assist with bulk order inquiries or technical affiliate support.

  • Sustainability Goal: We are continuously expanding our "Eco-Line," focusing on biodegradable films and recyclable paper options to meet the 2026 demand for green floristry.
payout_period: The first day of each month.
